Message:
Ah~ I desperately
wanted this hat,
yet I have already
grown tired of it.

No matter—
I can simply buy another one.

Whether it be dresses, banquets,
or even jewels in
every shade and sparkle...

There is nothing in this world
I cannot have.

And yet, why do I feel this way?
There is something missing.

I have everything
I could ever wish for
at my fingertips,
yet why am I left feeling...empty?

A stuffed doll slipped
out of my purse.

It was filthy,
and roughly patched together...
Where did this
even come from...?

“This thing is not
to my liking at all.”

I raised my arm,
preparing to throw away the doll.
“Don’t go, Big Sis...”

I found myself
clutching the doll
close to my chest,
keeping it safe.

Whose voice was that
just now...?

I have no idea.
No idea at all, but...

The pain I feel in my chest
is almost...suffocating...! Why...?

There should be nothing for me
to be sad about, yet...
these tears do not stop
pouring out...!

My gaze then met the doll’s.
Although its eyes were
coming apart at the seams,
I could not help but feel they
were trying to comfort “me”...

I held the doll tightly...
until all I could hear was
the sound of my own sobbing.
